subject.title: Sub-agent run timeout does not notify parent session (completion event silently dropped)

question: Should maintainers keep this issue as the canonical umbrella while repairing/reviewing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96189, or split the remaining no-output delivery wake into a narrower canonical item?
rationale: Current main only fixes the wait-layer slice; the remaining delivery-layer behavior has an open conflicting PR with proof and security concerns, so opening another automated fix lane now would risk duplicating or racing the active review path.

options.title: Keep Canonical And Review PR
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical tracker and focus maintainer review on repairing, proving, or replacing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96189.

options.title: Split A Narrow Delivery Issue
options.body: Open or designate a narrower canonical issue for the no-deliverable-payload terminal notice and leave this issue as the historical umbrella only after linking the replacement.

options.title: Close After PR Lands
options.body: Close this issue only after a delivery-layer fix lands with focused tests and live parent-wakeup proof.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical And Review PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical tracker and focus maintainer review on repairing, proving, or replacing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96189.
